what: Fixed a severe O(n^2) inefficiency in countDirect()
title: RaCInG 0.3.0
text: countDirect()’s cell-type-pair edge-counting step re-sliced full N x N adjacency matrix scratch every one nCells^2 cell-type pairs per simulated graph – redundant even within inner loop, since row-slice given source type doesn’t depend target type, yet recomputed per target type anyway. 106 cell types 11,236 redundant matrix re-slices per graph. Replaced single sparse matrix product (t(type_indicator) %*% Adj %*% type_indicator, type_indicator one-hot cell-type indicator matrix), computes full cell-type x cell-type edge-count matrix one pass. Verified numerically identical previous implementation; ~182x faster real data (106 cell types, 500 cells, average degree 20: 1.22s -> 0.007s per graph).

what: Monte Carlo memory and parallelization fixes
title: RaCInG 0.3.0
text: runSim()’s ncores > 1 path (parallel::makeCluster() + doParallel::registerDoParallel() + foreach, replacing previous fork-based parallel::mclapply() Windows portability) shipping full copy entire patient--ligand--receptor LRmatrix tensor every worker process, regardless patient count – 106 cell-type, 116-patient cohort meant ~460MB duplicated per worker even trivial single-patient run. Fixed pre-slicing LRmatrix/Cmatrix per patient making small slices foreach iteration variable (dispatched per task) instead name foreach broadcasts whole every worker; confirmed via monitored testing dropped per-worker overhead ~460MB MB. compute_results_processing()’s remove_direction column-merging grouped relabeled columns splitting pasted column-name string "_", silently scrambles cell-type identity whenever cell-type name contains "_" (e.g. multideconv’s method-tagged names like "CBSX_CBSX.HNSCC.scRNAseq_B.cells") – way tell, string alone, underscores separate two cell types pair underscores inside one cell type’s name. Fixed grouping underlying integer index grid instead re-parsing labels; added regression test. calculateDirect()/calculateWedges() silently dropped real patient names (always fell back "Patient_1", "Patient_2", …) even compute_kernel_features()/compute_racing_kernel() real ones available – "TT"/"GSCC" already used correctly. Fixed, kernel Monte Carlo feature matrices now use identical column-naming conventions ("Dir_A_B", "W_A_B_C", etc.) , outputs can fed downstream statistical/plotting functions interchangeably.

Every Monte Carlo simulation run real ligand-receptor network generated graphs wrong density (often drastically ) either direction, unrelated requested average degree. Simulation results computed earlier versions treated invalid re-run. Triangle features mislabeled. unbundled “trust triangle” (TT) computation actually computed cycle-triangle (CT) formula, true trust-triangle metric missing entirely; bundled 8-term formula dropped 6 8 terms. computeTriangles() now returns TT_* CT_* columns unbundled, correct 8-term sum bundled.
